name: Seeking Wisdom
summary: In Stormwind, Sven Yorgen asks Bishop Farthing for holy counsel on Duskwood. He sends Jitters' Completed Journal, hoping the bishop can reveal how to break Morbent Fel's shield.

sections.title: A Plea from the Shadows
sections.body: Duskwood suffers beneath old curses and ravenous undead. Stormwind's royal court has grown indifferent, and Sven Yorgen knows ordinary strength cannot pierce Morbent Fel's wards. Broken-hearted, he shelters at a camp near the borders and asks you to carry Jitters' assembled journal to the church. The road north leads to the Cathedral of Light.

sections.title: Counsel in the Cathedral
sections.body: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Bishop Farthing hears Duskwood's pleas. Jitters' account confirms Morbent Fel's power: vile sorcery shields the necromancer from ordinary blows. Courage alone cannot overcome those wards. To defeat him, an enchanted holy instrument must be found.

faq.q: Why does Sven send you to Bishop Farthing instead of King Anduin?
faq.answer: Sven trusts Bishop Farthing, a compassionate and learned man of the Holy Light who understands foul magic. Stormwind's nobility and army have largely left Darkshire and the surrounding lands to fend for themselves amid political paralysis, so Sven expects no soldiers from official channels.

faq.q: What is Jitters' journal and why does the Bishop need it?
faq.answer: Jitters recorded what happened around the attack on Sven's farm. Sven sends the completed account to Bishop Farthing so he can advise you as you prepare to face Morbent Fel.
Morbent Fel is a powerful necromancer seen at the Forlorn Rowe in Duskwood. He commands hordes of skeletal minions and shields himself with potent wards that turn aside normal weapons.
Bishop Farthing resides in the Cathedral of Light, the grand human cathedral in Stormwind City's Cathedral Square district.

faq.q: What happens after Bishop Farthing reads the journal?
faq.answer: Bishop Farthing explains that ordinary blows cannot harm Morbent Fel. He points you toward a sanctified relic that can dispel the necromancer's wards, beginning the search for the Doomed Fleet.

faq.q: Where does Sven Yorgen stay in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Sven Yorgen shelters at a small camp in northwestern Duskwood, near the river border. It lies south of Elwynn Forest and west of the haunted Raven Hill Cemetery.

angles.text: As a paladin, carrying pleas for holy aid from the abandoned borderlands to the Cathedral of Light tests the Silver Hand's duty to protect the forgotten and purge necromancy.
As a priest, Bishop Farthing offers guidance on how dark wards corrupt body and soul. Shadow sorcery calls for focused sanctification as well as the blade.
As an Alliance traveler, the journey reveals the divide between Stormwind City's guarded marble halls and Duskwood's forsaken towns. Those towns receive no garrison support.
